# strategy.result r1

strategy.result r1: one evaluated result of one strategy in one run, with its legs, checks and facts; insert only, a rerun is a new run_id.

| column | type | nullable | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| session_day | string (date) | no | Run day: the session day the rows were computed for. |
| run_id | string | no | Run id of the runner; a rerun is a new run_id and rows are insert-only. |
| strategy | string | no | Id of the strategy that computed the row, for example short_put. |
| rule_version | string | no | Version of the strategy rule that computed the row. |
| param_hash | string | no | Hash of the parameters the strategy ran with. |
| key | string | no | Key of the result, unique within a day and strategy. |
| underlying_id | integer | no | Identifier of the underlying instrument. |
| status | enum(ok, blocked, unknown) | no | Row status: blocked if any check blocked, else unknown if any check is unknown, else ok. |
| rank | integer | yes | Position of an ok row in the run; null when not ranked. |
| rank_in_underlying | integer | yes | Position of an ok row within its underlying; null when not ranked. |
| legs | string | no | JSON array text of the legs of the result. |
| checks | string | no | Ordered JSON array text of the check results. |
| facts | string | no | JSON object text of the figures of the result; an absent figure is omitted. |
| computed_at | string (date-time) | no | Instant the run computed the row, UTC; the newest run of a day is the one with the latest computed_at. |
| settings_version | integer | yes | Version of the owner settings the run used; null when the row was computed without owner settings. |

Primary key: (session_day, run_id, strategy, key)
